visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde hair tied back stands in a minimalist retail environment wearing a light blue and white striped cardigan, white top, and flare jeans. She holds a white cup while blue Pantone color swatches appear on the left. (2) The scene cuts as she transitions into a pink matching set consisting of an oversized shirt, shorts, and a small pink bag. She poses confidently while pink and white Pantone swatches are displayed. (3) She shifts into a cream-colored tiered dress over a sage green t-shirt, carrying a small matching green purse. The background features bright indoor lighting and a wall with the text 'CHANGE STARTS FROM TRYING'. (4) She wears dark grey overalls over a grey t-shirt with a plaid shirt tied at her waist and a grey cap. The lighting remains soft and even. (5) The camera captures wide shots of a large retail store interior filled with clothing racks, mannequins, and stacks of colorful t-shirts on tables. (6) The woman interacts with the t-shirts, holding a white one against herself and showing the fabric quality. (7) She appears outdoors on a yellow and blue playground structure under bright natural sunlight, wearing a beige t-shirt. (8) At the store counter, she carries multiple branded shopping bags, smiling and waving as the video concludes.
